name: fireball-commit
intent: Ember charge grows at a source node, launches 216px across a track, and impacts a target to confirm — progressive fire commit, not a fade.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Target resolves directly to CONFIRMED; no ember charge, launch, or impact

acceptance: Idle shows no orb; Run enters CHARGING with 4 ember sparks at source for chargeMs 380
After charge, LAUNCHED travels travelPx 216 in launchMs 220; mid-flight orb is visible on track
Impact flash plays impactMs 200 then settleMs 150 before CONFIRMED lights the target ring
Replay resets to IDLE then re-runs the full charge→launch→impact chain
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows CONFIRMED immediately with animations disabled
